test_title: PYST 58: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 3% per year rate of interest for 2 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Rate of Interest (R) = 3% per year

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = (2500 × 3 × 2) / 100

⇒ SI = (2500 × 6) / 100

⇒ SI = 150

**The simple interest is ₹150.**
